definitions.explanation: A rentable locker found at train stations, airports, and tourist sites, used to leave luggage or shopping for a few hours. From English "coin locker"; most now take IC cards as well as coins.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧コインロッカー⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{預|あず}けた→預ける：01819_azukeru⟧。
examples.english: I left my luggage in a coin locker at the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧コインロッカー⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{空|あ}いています→空く：11062_aku⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Are any of the large coin lockers free?

examples.japanese: ⟦{観光|かんこう}→観光：00173_kankou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦スーツケース→スーツケース：01781_suutsukeesu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧コインロッカー⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧おこう。

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- コインロッカー⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{預|あず}ける→預ける：01819_azukeru⟧: to leave (something) in a coin locker
- コインロッカー⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{空|あ}いている→空く：11062_aku⟧: a coin locker is free
- コインロッカー⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{満杯|まんぱい}→満杯：18053_manpai⟧: the coin lockers are all full

USAGE:
Lockers are sized {小|しょう}・⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧・{大|だい} and priced accordingly, and most have a same-day or overnight limit. For longer or oversized storage travelers use a staffed {手荷物預|てにもつあず}かり{所|じょ} (baggage room) instead.
